digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation scoping and manifest signing
propositions: A declared-none file impact scope should retain certified status after unrelated commits move HEAD, instead of falling back to whole-HEAD stale-head drift like undeclared empty-impact tickets.

The file-scope classifier must distinguish three cases: non-empty dependency paths (paths), empty dependencies with explicit own_scope none (none), and all other empty cases (unscoped), with signed manifests emitting exactly one file-scope: none declaration only for the none case.

Material fingerprints must add a canonical JSON basis member for none scope only, making reason-only edits and scope flips result in stale-material, while preserving byte-identical output for legacy paths and unscoped tickets.

Manifest readers must treat file-scope: none only when present and authenticated; absent or malformed declarations default to unscoped with whole-HEAD freshness, preserving fail-closed behavior on rollback.

The recovery re-sign path must preserve none scope through the existing signing boundary without new branches, and validation across signed records, tamper scenarios, and material transitions must all pass with stateful ticket fingerprint contracts.
